$comment: Flat two-tone map on paper, from Gable's `warm` theme, light scheme (gable app/src/lib/sites/theme-presets.json, 2026-10-06): paper #faf6f0, tint #f2eadf, line #e4d9ca, line-strong #8c7d6f, ink-2 #5c5045, ink #1c1712, accent #a3441c, on-panel #fbf6ef. Gable owns presets; this file is the starting point. labels (2026-10-06): road and place names in ink-2 #5c5045 (quieter than the ink #1c1712 of the major roads, darker than line-strong #8c7d6f so 11 px stays legible) with a paper #faf6f0 halo and plaque; tertiary is included because Mo i Rana's main streets (Kirkegata, Elias Blix' gate, Ole Tobias Olsens gate) are tertiary in OSM.
name: paper-warm
description: Ink roads on warm paper; water and buildings as quiet tints.
